headline: Nifty tests 22,600 support as US tech selloff and surging oil prices weigh on Indian market sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Revived doubts regarding AI growth triggered a 2.5% slump in the Nasdaq and a broader tech selloff
Crude oil prices jumped to a five-month high, impacting trade setups for the Indian market
Domestic indices faced pressure as Nifty 50 tumbled below the 22,700 psychological mark
Drag in heavyweights across IT, FMCG, and Media sectors contributed to the Sensex's 400-point decline
whatHappening: US markets traded lower with the S&P 500 falling 1% due to tech-sector weakness
PM Modi warned that trade, technology, and sea routes are being weaponized in the changing world order
Nifty 50 found immediate support at the 22,600 level following a sharp intraday plunge
Barclays is cutting 5,000 jobs globally as part of an AI-led cost-reduction strategy
summary: Indian indices are under pressure as Nifty tests the 22,600 support level following a sharp tech selloff in US markets. Rising oil prices and sectoral drags in IT and FMCG have dampened investor sentiment. Global concerns over AI and geopolitical shifts highlighted by PM Modi continue to influence market direction.
